report.interpretation: Agency gain/loss maps reflect year-to-year mapped-coverage set differences, while class swaps between seagrass and algae are separate. Both are remote-sensing map labels, not independent biological recovery or plant mortality.
report.precision: Source values rounded to 0.001 acres; absolute source residual tolerance 0.025 acre.
report.source_validation_type: Originally independent source acreage/geometries but shared SWFWMD remote sensing; not independent ecological studies
